payload.claim: The comment explaining scope_proposal.json's own `sha256` field says 'This wrapper holds raw text, so it carries its own hash too,' but holding raw text is not why the envelope needs a separate hash. plan.json needs no embedded hash because the whole file *is* the raw block (so `sha256sum plan.json` matches the PLAN line); scope_proposal.json needs one precisely because it is *not* the raw block but a JSON wrapper around a 'raw' key, so a whole-file sha256 would not match the hash of just that field. 'This wrapper holds raw text, so it carries its own hash too' states the opposite causal relationship from the one that actually holds, attaching the wrong 'why' to the fact it documents.
